lines.name: 40 corner and 8 tee gussets, laser cut 1/8 inch 6061
lines.note: Two repeated aluminum profiles. Includes material, cutting and deburring.

lines.name: 4 stainless axle hangers
lines.note: One 304 stainless profile for all three wheels. Bore finishing after drawing review.

lines.name: 2 pneumatic trail wheels, 15 inch 4.00-8
lines.note: $32.89 each, no bulk discount assumed. Ball bearings, 5/8 inch bore and a 4 inch hub are stated by the supplier.

lines.name: Front swivel caster, 10 inch pneumatic, with four bolts
lines.note: Harbor Freight 63799 at $19.99, 300 lb working load stated, no swivel lock. Mounting height not stated by the supplier.

lines.name: 2 stock-shaft axles, sleeves, spacers, washers and cotters
lines.note: Plain 5/8 inch shaft cut and cross-drilled. No threaded journals.

lines.name: 166 sleeved bolted joints
lines.note: Zinc-plated grade 5 bolts, lock nuts and washers at Bolt Depot prices: per 1,000 for the batch, whole boxes of 100 for one build. Cut steel sleeves are an allowance.

lines.name: Floor and ramp panels, sealed 15/32 inch ACX plywood
lines.note: 1 sheet at $52.00 plus edge and face sealing. Offcuts are charged.

lines.name: Hinge, two latches, safety strap hardware and stand feet
lines.note: Stainless continuous hinge, two draw latches, two leveling feet with tube inserts, carriage bolts.

lines.name: Wheel chocks, grip, tip-stop feet and floor fasteners
lines.note: Two rubber wheel chocks stand in for a parking brake during bench trials. No wheel brake is designed.

lines.name: Printed service parts and fixtures
lines.note: About 1.3 liters of solid part volume, most of it the three ramp toes. Priced as consumed filament with a reject reserve, not a printer.

lines.name: Cutting, drilling, deburring and assembly labor
lines.note: Batch: 5.5 h at $25/h. One-off: 15 h. Roughly 300 tube-wall holes per carrier. Timing assumptions, not observed.

lines.name: Packaging
lines.note: Large flat-pack carton set. Outbound freight is separate.

lines.name: Inbound freight allocation
lines.note: Truck freight for long bars in a batch; parcel shipping for one build. Unquoted.

evidence.name: Metals Depot T3118-6061, 1 x 1 x 1/8 inch 6061-T6 square tube
evidence.note: Read in a browser 2026-11-12: $116.16, in stock, about $4.84 per foot. Chassis members. No quantity break shown. A 24 ft bar ships by truck.

evidence.name: Metals Depot T31116, 1 x 1 x 1/16 inch 6063-T52 square tube
evidence.note: Read in a browser 2026-11-12: $65.73, in stock, about $3.13 per foot. Cabin and secondary members. 6063-T52 is softer than 6061-T6; Online Metals 6061 in .065 wall was $60.03 per 12 ft, about $5.00 per foot.

evidence.name: Zoro Select 1NWV4 pneumatic wheel, 4.00-8
evidence.note: Read in a browser 2026-11-12: $32.89. Supplier states 15 3/16 inch diameter, 3 1/8 inch width, ball bearings, 5/8 inch bore, 4 inch hub length and a 435 lb load. Weight not stated. The rating does not rate the carrier.

evidence.name: HAUL-MASTER 67467 pneumatic wheel, 13 x 4 inch
evidence.note: Read in a browser 2026-11-12: $14.99. 5/8 inch bore, 4.7 lb, supplier working load 300 lb. The page states no bearing type or hub length.

evidence.name: Bolt Depot 328, 1/4-20 x 2 inch grade 5 zinc hex bolt
evidence.note: Read in a browser 2026-11-12. Lock nut 2624 is $5.19 per 100 and $45.70 per 1,000. SAE washer 2976 is $3.10 per 100 and $24.80 per 1,000. The 18-8 stainless bolt 133 is $30.75 per 100.

evidence.name: Home Depot 15/32 inch x 4 x 8 ft ACX radiata pine sanded plywood, model 80496
evidence.note: Read on a store category listing 2026-11-12: $52.00, in stock at one Los Angeles area store. Store prices vary.

evidence.name: Burley Bark Ranger XL at Tree Fort Bikes
evidence.note: Observed $729.95. A bike trailer with a stroller kit, 100 lb stated capacity. A market reference, never a Rover cost input.

evidence.note: Observed $900.91 sale price. Source of the stated 36.2 x 22.4 x 29.9 inch interior, 33 lb weight and 9 inch step-up.

allowances: Tube for one build: the supplier ships bars over 8 ft by truck, so the one-carrier scenario buys 8 ft bars at $58.08 for the 1/8 inch 6061-T6 and $41.60 for the 1/16 inch 6063-T52, both read on the supplier page. The batch buys 24 ft and 21 ft bars.

Front caster: priced as Harbor Freight 63799 at $19.99, whose mounting height the supplier does not state. CasterHQ CB-SPC10 at $79.00 states every dimension the design uses: 12-1/4 inch overall height, 7-1/4 inch swivel radius, a plate slotted to take the same bolt pattern, 350 lb. A Service Caster model with a swivel lock was seen at $64.69 on a search listing with a 12-3/16 inch mounting height.

Parking: no wheel brake is designed. Two rubber wheel chocks are in the controls allowance for bench trials. Cart floor locks were read at $42.00 to $100.00, but the one that fits under the floor hangs about 11 mm above the ground when retracted, so it is not used.

Plates: SendCutSend lists .125 inch 6061-T6 and .125 inch 304 stainless for laser cutting, accepts DXF, has no minimum quantity, ships laser parts in 1 to 3 days and ships free in the US over $39. No quote was run, so the gusset and hanger lines stay allowances.
Crush sleeves: $0.21 each in a batch and $0.30 for one build is an allowance, the same as the XL r1 study. Bolts, nuts and washers are observed prices.
Run wheels: $60 each is an allowance. No 20 inch pneumatic wheel with a 5/8 inch bore and a suitable rating was found, so the 20 inch wheel remains an open selection.

Gussets, hangers, axle stock, hinge, latches, brake, leveling feet, grip, rivet nuts, ridge pole and bedding tape are allowances. Search results suggested a heavy 36 inch stainless hinge can cost far more than the allowance; none of those pages was read.

Brake: two wheelchair wheel-lock sets were read in a browser, Quickie push-to-lock at $110.00 a pair and a Medline pediatric set at $31.85 a pair. Both are made for specific wheelchair frames and neither is selected.
Stainless option: the stainless bolt is an observed $30.75 per 100. Stainless nuts and washers were not priced; the $0.23 per joint upgrade includes a $0.10 allowance for them.

Mill-quantity tube: the second total prices tube by weight at $4.00 per pound plus 8% scrap. That rate is an assumption with no quote behind it. The listed-price total stays the headline until a mill or distributor quote exists.
